# Nivra 0.1.0-alpha.14 — Release recovery and compatibility

## Publishing and updates
- Uses a new version, installer filename, GitHub tag and signed manifest. Does not replace either previously distributed alpha.13 variant.
- New native publisher uses an isolated clone. It does not reset, clean, stage, commit, overwrite or delete files in the user's existing release checkout.
- Re-running the SAME publisher verifies an identical existing asset and resumes missing metadata publication. Draft uploads can resume without creating a second release.
- A different installer hash under the same version is a hard conflict. Public assets and tags are never overwritten, deleted or clobbered.
- Published and installed versions are displayed separately. Already installed is not reported as a failed update, and a newer installed build is not downgraded.
- The publisher waits for the expected Ed25519-signed Pages manifest and SHA-256, not just a version string.

## Compatibility work
- Resolve modern Windows Codex npm packages to their native executable (hoisted, nested and legacy layouts); no shell shim fallback.
- Explicit model refresh can restart an idle app-server to refresh its in-memory catalogue. A working turn or summary is not interrupted. All pagination pages and provider-supplied reasoning levels remain supported.
- Global Stop and the chat Stop button are connected to the existing stop endpoint. Pending and cancelled states are visible.
- Blender tooling includes verified viewport captures, recovery copies, project-local .blend opening and Full-access-only advanced bpy tasks with a recovery copy. Full-access bpy execution is NOT an operating-system sandbox and cannot be interrupted during every synchronous operator.
- Normal Blender file tools remain project-restricted. Private artifact destinations are supplied by Nivra, not by the model. Captures are bounded, decoded PNGs before they can become image input.
- Existing Unity/Unreal integration code is retained. No claim of live engine validation in this build environment.

## Test boundary
100 top-level application tests and 11 subtests passed; 2 live-engine tests were skipped.
15 publisher tests passed, including a real local-Git isolated-clone test and fixture-based GitHub retry/conflict tests.
Race detector, vet, JS/Python syntax, six model parser assertions and an isolated Chromium UI test passed.
Windows executables are cross-compiled. No live Windows/WebView2, bpy, Unity/Unreal Editor, authenticated model session or public release signing was run here.
